run_GazeboInterface: run the GazeboInterface class to set robot joint angles and reset the simulation
create_GazeboInterface: create a GazeboInterface instance to control LoCoBot robot joints and pause or resume simulation
test_set_robot: test the set_robot method to publish joint angle commands to all 9 robot joints
test_set_arm: test the set_arm method to publish joint angle commands to the 5 arm joints
review_GazeboInterface_reset_robot: review the GazeboInterface reset_robot method that calls the Gazebo reset_simulation service
